title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword Game Moves Release Date Forward to September 4
content: CAPCOM revealed on the official X/Twitter account for its Onimusha : Way of the Sword game on Thursday it will now release the game three weeks earlier on September 4. The game was previously slated to launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC via Steam, and Switch on September 25.
author: ANN

title: Witch and Hound TV Anime Announced, Original Author Joins Series Composition
content: Rainy Kamitsuki dark fantasy light novel Witch and Hound is officially getting a TV anime adaptation. The announcement included the release of the first teaser trailer, teaser visual, and main staff details. The anime will be directed by Takanori Tsujimoto, with Kengo Saito handling character designs.
author: Anime Corner

title: Black Clover Season 2 Main Visual Starring Asta, Yuno and Noelle Revealed
content: Black Clover Season 2 has revealed the main visual featuring Asta, Yuno and Noelle ahead of the anime’s October 2026 return. title: Short Story 'Rusuban' Gets Short Anime Movie for August 2026
content: Animation studio Rock'n Roll Mountain announced a short anime movie adaptation of Akiko Okuda 's Rusuban ( Babysitting ) short manga story on Thursday, revealing the cast, staff, a visual (pictured), and a trailer.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Yoshitaka Amano's Original Anime 'Zan' in Production
content: Yoshitaka Amano 's newest company, Yoshitaka Amano Inc., announced on Thursday that the previously announced Zan anime project is in production and revealed the main staff. The pilot will be shown at the Anime Expo 2026 convention on July 3.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Additional Cast for 'Mebius Dust' Announced
content: The official website for the Mebius Dust television anime announced additional cast on Thursday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on Tokyo MX at 11.30 p.m. followed by BS Fuji and MBS on July 9.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Light Novel 'Majo to Ryouken' Gets TV Anime
content: Production company Pony Canyon opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Rainy Kamitsuki 's Majo to Ryouken ( Witch and Hound ) light novel on Thursday and revealed the main staff, teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Yoshitaka Amano's ZAN Anime Project Reveals Staff of Mecha Anime Veterans
content: ZAN , artist Yoshitaka Amano 's anime project based on his DEVA ZAN art, announced its staff on Thursday. title: Witch and Hound Fantasy Light Novels Get TV Anime
content: Pony Canyon announced on Thursday that Kamitsuki Rainy 's Witch and Hound ( Majo to Ryōken ) light novel series is inspiring a television anime. The anime's official website unveiled a teaser promotional video, which announces the anime's staff, as well as a teaser visual.
